  run:
    $ set -e

    $ apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 update
    $ apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold install -y --no-upgrade docker-ce-rootless-extras uidmap

step 2: check rootlesskit's AppArmor profile
  apparmor: Ubuntu restricts unprivileged user namespaces, so the rootlesskit profile docker-ce-rootless-extras installs must be loaded before the user's daemon can start
  run:
    $ grep -q rootlesskit /sys/kernel/security/apparmor/profiles || { echo "AppArmor restricts unprivileged user namespaces and no rootlesskit profile is loaded after installing docker-ce-rootless-extras. Load it with systemctl reload apparmor, check aa-status lists rootlesskit, and run host admit again"; exit 1; }
